about: A number of a theme outside the bounds of the theme schema, or not finite (x-themeNumbers): replaced by the value of the same token and field in the built-in theme of the same brightness when it has one, otherwise by the nearest bound. Each row puts «value» at «place» in a copy of the built-in theme of «brightness» and expects the number the reader draws with. JSON has no infinity: «value» is then the string "Infinity" or "-Infinity" (a JSON parser reads 1e309 as infinity). «replacedBy» null means the number is inside the bounds and stays. Written by hand.
placeNote: «place» names the dictionary, the token and, for a composite value, the field; «layer» is the index of a shadow layer, «stop» the index of a gradient stop. A token the built-in theme lacks is a custom token.
